title: The avatar column is blank only with no lead and no line technician
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. One work order with no lead and no assigned line technician; another with at least one.
custom_steps:
1. View both work orders.
  2. Confirm the avatar field/column is blank only for the one with no lead and no line technician.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The avatar field/column is blank only when there is no lead technician and no assigned line technician.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10050 — Story 7 Line technicians on cards and rows. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S7-N1 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
